runs.latencyProtocol: Separate stage instances and indexes; index prebuilt with listSymbols; native worker prewarmed with identical tiny method. First pass then two repeated passes, alternating stage order. Wall time includes retrieval and real tool formatting, excludes setup and metric computation. No live LSP, model, network, or token measurement.
runs.managedProtocol: Primary comparison: both stages at limits.maxChars=22000. Production-budget comparison: the same stage2 raw result at limits.maxChars=36000. Retain 20000 default-tool results separately. All replays use real ProjectToolsService.search; chars and evidence come from actual result blocks. replayFormattingMs excludes retrieval and is not end-to-end latency. The old global 60000/new 128000-character docs/rules envelope is outside this benchmark. Equal tool budgets do not equalize version-specific internal snippet budgets.
